capture_sequence: copy tests/_org/2022.1/SampleProject.wproj source fixture into a sandbox
discover deterministic Event/State/Switch/RTPC/listener/game-object prerequisites where the copied SampleProject exposes them
call ak.wwise.core.profiler.startCapture and record returned capture cursor
subscribe to captureLog.itemAdded, gameObjectRegistered/gameObjectUnregistered, stateChanged, switchChanged, or the narrowest available profiler topic for each URI
trigger each attempted ak.soundengine.* URI with deterministic sandbox arguments only when prerequisites are present
bounded-wait per URI for matching profiler/captureLog/topic payload fields
call ak.wwise.core.profiler.stopCapture and record returned capture cursor
cleanup: stop all playback and stop/destroy transient transports if created for event probes
unregister game objects and reset listeners/default listeners if registration reached action phase
delete sandbox unless keep-on-failure policy applies
prove source fixture mtime and bounded hash are unchanged
